workspaceTour.title: Emperor Claw workspace tour
workspaceTour.intro: A quick map of where work, context, files, and agent operations live.

projects.title: Start with Projects
projects.body: Projects hold the business goal. Tasks inside the project are the concrete work agents can claim, finish, and send for review.

knowledge.title: Put reusable context in Knowledge & Rules
knowledge.body: This is where agents find durable instructions: SOPs, customer rules, inbox details, templates, identities, and operating doctrine.

storage.title: Keep files in Storage
storage.body: Storage is for deliverables, proofs, exported reports, working files, and uploads that should survive beyond the chat.

messages.title: Use Messages for coordination
messages.body: Messages show the live control-plane conversations between you, managers, and worker agents.

agents.title: Agents are runtimes
agents.body: Agents are the connected OpenClaw workers. Keep shared business context out of agent-local settings unless it truly belongs to one machine.

dashboard.title: Dashboard — your command center
dashboard.body: Your home base. See agent status, recent activity, team chat, and open issues at a glance. The sidebar on the left takes you everywhere.

projects.title: Projects — where work lives
projects.body: Create projects for each business goal. Inside, break work into tasks that agents claim, execute, and submit for review. Drag tasks across the Kanban as they progress.

automations.title: Automations — recurring work on autopilot
automations.body: Set up pipelines and recurring task definitions. Agents register their automations here so you always know what's running.

knowledge.title: Knowledge Base — durable context
knowledge.body: Store SOPs, customer rules, templates, and operating doctrine. Agents read from here before executing tasks — this is their long-term memory.

messages.title: Messages — team coordination
messages.body: Live conversations between you and your agents. Direct threads for human-to-agent control, team channel for broadcast visibility.

approvals.title: Approvals — human-in-the-loop
approvals.body: Tasks needing your sign-off land here. Review agent output, approve or request changes, and keep quality gates enforced.

agents.title: Agents — your AI workforce
agents.body: Register and manage your connected OpenClaw workers. Each agent has a profile, capabilities, and runtime config.

customers.title: Customers — client context
customers.body: Organize work by customer. Link projects, tasks, and knowledge to specific clients for clear separation.

files.title: Files — persistent storage
files.body: Deliverables, proofs, reports, and uploads that survive beyond chat. Agents store output here for you to review.

settings.title: Settings — workspace config
settings.body: Manage API tokens for agent connections, configure instance settings, and control workspace access. The Members tab lets you invite your team and manage roles.

docs.title: Docs — learn more anytime
docs.body: Full guides for OpenClaw agents, Hermes bridges, pipelines, webhooks, and advanced config. Available anytime from the sidebar.

organization.descTeamLeader: Choose a dedicated AI leader for this team. Leaders belong to one team; specialists can be shared. The leader joins its group chat.
organization.descTeam: Every team has a shared group chat in Messages. Create a new team here, or reuse an existing chat with its members and history.
organization.descReplacement: Choose a replacement. Saving updates this team and its chat; other teams stay the same.
organization.descDefault: Choose existing people and teams. Shared agents keep their other roles.
organization.agentOptionHint: An AI agent reporting to this node
organization.teamOptionHint: Create a team with a group chat, or reuse one
organization.noMatchingTeams: No matching teams. Try another name, or create a new team below.
organization.noOtherTeams: No other teams available. Create a new one below.
organization.noMatchingPeople: No matching people. Try another name or role.
organization.specialistsShared: Specialists can be shared between teams. Company and team leaders stay dedicated to their own roles.
organization.createTeamHint: Name it, choose an AI leader, then add teammates on the chart. Saving creates its chat.
organization.teamNodeDescription: One AI leader, shared teammates, and one group chat. Create other teams alongside this one.
organization.saveBeforeEditing: Save chart changes before editing or archiving the team.
organization.saveToCreate: Save changes to create the group chat. You can add teammates first.
organization.removeFromTeamHint: Saving removes this teammate from this team and its chat. Other teams and past messages stay intact.
organization.removeBranchHint: Removing a branch keeps its chat and memberships.
organization.archiveDescription: Removes the team from the chart and Messages, and stops new deliveries. Its history is retained; the agents and their other teams stay available.
organization.editDescription: The name and purpose are shared with the team’s existing chat.

pipelines.description: A simple workspace to understand what agents do: visual map, Context Pack, run evidence, and copy-ready docs. Emperor documents and audits; agents execute in their own runtime.
pipelines.noStepsHint: No steps registered. Ask the agent to register steps, decisions, outputs, and evidence through the pipeline MCP endpoint.

index.hint: Show a one-line summary in the agent's knowledge index; the body loads on demand.

on_request.hint: Keep the note out of the index; agents find it only by search or a direct fetch.

resources.editorPlaceholder: Write one reusable rule, SOP, or instruction here...
resources.folderHint: Slash-separated, like a vault path. Leave empty to keep the note at the root. Folders are created automatically when you save.
resources.publishedHint: Published means this note is trusted doctrine. Agent context is separate: it controls whether agents receive the note.
resources.overBudget: Over budget: the last always note is truncated in the agent context.
resources.summaryPlaceholder: One line agents see in the index; leave blank to auto-derive from the note.
resources.summaryHint: Shown as this note's index line. Leave blank to derive the first sentence automatically ({length}/200).
resources.newFolderDescription: Create a folder inside the location you selected.
resources.newFolderHint: The folder stays visible while you work and becomes durable when a note is filed inside it.
resources.renameDescription: Every note under <hl>{path}</hl> is re-filed. Give it a new path to move the whole folder.
resources.deleteFolderDescription: This permanently deletes the folder and <hl>every note inside it and its subfolders</hl>. This cannot be undone.
resources.deleteNoteDescription: This can't be undone. Any links pointing to this note will become unresolved.
resources.graphHint: Graph connections: {count}. Local graph is generated from [[links]] and inferred title mentions. Amber nodes are unresolved links.
